title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Saja Boys Members Andrew Choi and Neckwav Set Live U.K. Performance Debut in London
summary: The voices of Jinu and Abby from the Netflix global phenomenon are slated to play Outernet Live for one night only.
contentText:
Two of the voices of the international Netflix smash KPop Demon Hunters are prepping for their live U.K. performance debut. Andrew Choi and Neckwav, who, respectively, provided the singing voices of Jinu and Abby in the animated film will take the stage for one night only at Outernet Live in Central London on Sept. 6.

According to a release, as fans arrive for the show at the 2,000-capacity venue they will be greeted by a new, specially commissioned immersive artist experience that will play on massive screens across the larger Outernet London district.

“We’re incredibly excited to be sharing the stage during our first-ever performance in London,” said Choi in a statement. “The connection everyone has built with the film’s characters has been beyond anything we could have imagined and seeing our UK fans embrace the music makes this an even more meaningful celebration.”

Tickets for the event can be purchased here .

Neckwav (born Kyung Jay Minn), added, “It is an honour to bring my voice as Neckwav, and the singing voice behind Abby Saja, to life at Outernet Live. The love and support from our UK fans has been amazing and having the chance to finally meet and perform for them in person makes this moment so special. This will be a night to remember!”

In the film, demons in disguise from the Saja Boys boy band — which also includes Kevin Woo (Mystery), samUIL Lee (Romance) — battle against demon-hunting vocal trio HUNTR/X. The Saja Boys’ hits include the fizzy pop banger “Soda Pop” and the darker-edged “Your Idol.”
